plugins.name: orch
plugins.description: Multi-session orchestration framework. Coordinate parallel Claude Code sessions using Alpha (brain), Beta/Gamma (builders), Delta (verification), and Polish (cleanup).

skills.name: alpha
skills.description: Alpha — the brain session of a multi-session orchestrated effort. Plans the effort, writes the coordination file with per-session prompts and API contracts, commits each round once Delta's mechanical checks pass, then does design review. Never writes code. Invoke with /alpha to start or resume an effort.
skills.description_zh: 担任多会话协作的规划与协调会话，编写含各会话任务和 API 约定的协调文件，在 Delta 机械检查通过后提交每轮工作并进行设计复核；不写代码。通过 /alpha 启动或恢复。

skills.name: beta
skills.description: Beta — a builder session in a multi-session orchestrated effort. Reads the Beta Prompt from the coordination file and executes it, staying inside its assigned file ownership and API contracts. Invoke with /beta in its own terminal after Alpha has planned the effort.
skills.description_zh: 担任多会话协作中的 Beta 开发会话，读取协调文件的 Beta Prompt，在分配的文件责任范围和 API 约定内执行。Alpha 完成规划后，在独立终端通过 /beta 启动。

skills.name: delta
skills.description: Delta — the mechanical verification gate of a multi-session orchestrated effort. Runs typecheck, lint, tests, build, and smoke tests, then reports pass/fail into the coordination file. Never edits code, never gives design opinions. Invoke with /delta after coding sessions finish and before Alpha's design review.
skills.description_zh: 担任多会话协作的机械验证关卡，执行类型检查、lint、测试、构建和冒烟检查，将通过或失败写入协调文件；不修改代码或发表设计意见。在编码结束、Alpha 设计复核前通过 /delta 启动。

skills.name: gamma
skills.description: Gamma — a builder session in a multi-session orchestrated effort. Reads the Gamma Prompt from the coordination file and executes it, staying inside its assigned file ownership and API contracts. Invoke with /gamma in its own terminal after Alpha has planned the effort.
skills.description_zh: 担任多会话协作中的 Gamma 开发会话，读取协调文件的 Gamma Prompt，在指定文件责任范围和 API 约定内执行。Alpha 完成规划后，在独立终端通过 /gamma 启动。

skills.name: polish
skills.description: Polish — applies the polish items Alpha wrote into this session's coordination-file section after design review. Makes only the listed fixes, no refactors or new features. Invoke with /polish in the session terminal that owns the work.
skills.description_zh: 在负责工作的会话终端通过 /polish 执行 Alpha 设计复核后列入该会话协调文件章节的完善项，仅修复清单所列事项，不重构或增加功能。
